package.description: Explorer thumbnails for 369 file types Windows can't read, plus a right-click image toolkit.

en-US.description: Explorer thumbnails for 369 file types Windows can't read, plus a right-click image toolkit.
en-US.longDescription: SageThumbs 2K is a modern, crash-isolated Windows 11 shell extension written in Rust that rebuilds the classic SageThumbs. It gives File Explorer thumbnails for 369 file types Windows can't preview on its own — camera RAW, HEIC/AVIF, Photoshop, DjVu, ebooks and comics, video frames, 3D-print files and a long tail of obscure formats — plus a right-click image toolkit (convert, resize, rotate, OCR, color picker, metadata strip, combine-to-PDF/CBZ) and a console/AI CLI. Free for personal use.
en-US.name: SageThumbs 2K
en-US.releaseNotes:
## TL;DR **≡ƒåò New** - **VectorCraft `.vectorcraft` files get thumbnails (#83)** - **DSDIFF `.dff` audio gets album-art thumbnails** **≡ƒöü Changed** - **Settings opens with the common options; an Advanced switch shows the rest** - **The Settings "Advanced" page is now called "Repair & updates"** - **The "Menu preview" option sits right under the right-click menu switch** **≡ƒ⌐╣ Fixed** - **Six translations name the screenshot tool one way**
Read more: everything in 4.2.0 - **DSDIFF (`.dff`) audio gets album-art thumbnails.** The DSDIFF file (Philips' DSD Interchange File Format) is read by hand, the way `.dsf` already is: its ID3v2 tag is found whether it sits inside the file's form or after it, and the largest front-cover picture is shown. Files with no cover keep the default icon. - **Settings has an Advanced switch (top right of every page, left of the search box).** Off, the window shows a Basic view: the options most people change, on nine of the twelve pages (the Ebook/comic, Screenshot files and Quick action pages are Advanced only), with a note at the foot saying so. On shows every option, as before. The switch applies at once and is remembered; every copy that already existed keeps the full view, only a fresh install starts on Basic. Opening a page, or picking a search result, that Basic hides turns Advanced on. Options hidden by Basic keep the values they have, and Save and Reset Settings treat them as before. - **The Settings page called "Advanced" is now "Repair & updates"**, which is what it holds (diagnostics, rebuilding the thumbnail cache, repairing file associations, updates, the hotkey service). - **The "Menu preview" option sits right under the right-click menu switch.** The dropdown moved up to sit under "Enable the right-click menu", the switch it belongs to. - **VectorCraft `.vectorcraft` files (and the former `.drawcraft` name) get thumbnails.** The thumbnail is the file's embedded preview picture when it has one, else page one of the PDF VectorCraft embeds by default, drawn by the same PDF renderer `.ai` files use. Files saved without either show the stock icon. Compressed (gzip) files are read too. (#83) - **Danish, German, Persian, Russian, Slovenian and Thai use one name for the screenshot tool.** A few lines on the Supporter and trial screens named it with a second word or spelling (German, for example, said both "Screenshot-Werkzeug" and "Screenshot-Tool"). Each of the six now uses the name its feature list shows. - **Licence:** a subscription's Licence page shows its paid-through date and a Manage billing button, and every licensed copy is offered every update. A copy installed for home use can start the 7-day business trial there, with no reinstall.
